packageRules.description: The Angular ecosystem moves in lockstep - update it as one PR, not one per package.
@angular/compiler-cli@22 peers on typescript >=6.0 <6.1; without this, Renovate races ahead to a TypeScript major that breaks the build before Angular itself is ready for it.
Majors need a human to actually look at them before they land.
docs/ intentionally mirrors the pinned Docusaurus stack used by the sibling ngx-translate-routes docs site - don't chase latest here independently.
